doc.title: DrumDrill drum key (where each kit piece is written)
doc.legend: Neither syllabus prints a drum key. Only the items whose src is not pending-pas-weinberg are confirmed by public official documents; the rest is a common convention, to be checked against the PAS Weinberg guide.
